answer: To bind a LinkedIn profile to an agent, the registry runs a decryption-based possession proof. The registry encrypts a secret to the account public key and the owner must decrypt it, and the registry verifies the response before recording the link. The inlet of the check is the signature itself; a vine in the response invalidates the claim, and a forge of mismatched links is rejected, so a Sybil cannot borrow a LinkedIn profile to multiply identities.
